exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: usability.complete_filter: retain only correctly sent samples where whole password was typed before send

inputBoundary: One explicit source-aligned boolean states whether the whole password was typed before the Send action for one sample.
outputBoundary: Exclude the sample as incomplete when the predicate is false and retain it when true.
limitations: The source defines sent-off-correctly with i.e. as the whole password having been typed before Send; this binding does not invent a second independent correctness predicate.
This binding does not parse raw key or Send events or reconstruct their ordering.
This binding does not reconstruct the typed password or choose character, correction, or edit semantics.
This binding does not reproduce the study's manual dataset corrections.
This binding does not calculate entry time, error rate, or another downstream usability measure.
A missing whole-password-before-Send predicate fails closed rather than being interpreted as false.
